title: Chicago Ep1 - Sharing is Caring
lesson: The best souvenir from any city is the friends you make.
narration: Abdul just landed in Chicago - and WOW, look at that! Navy Pier sparkled, the lake shimmered, and the skyline touched the clouds. Then Abdul spotted two kids by the Ferris wheel - Mia and Leo. They looked lost, and their tummies were rumbling. So Abdul ran over and shared his map and his snack - and just like that, they were best friends! Together they shared a cheesy deep-dish pizza. Then they laughed at their silly reflections in the Bean and played until sunset! The best souvenir from any city? The friends you make! Next stop - New York!

beats.objective: HOOK: extreme close-up of Abdul's face, huge sparkling hazel eyes, mouth open in amazement showing a tooth gap, white kufi tilted, freckles, golden city bokeh. Reaction BEFORE the reveal.
REVEAL: wide shot, Abdul seen from behind at the Navy Pier railing with arms wide open, real Chicago skyline (Willis Tower, Hancock Center) across Lake Michigan in golden morning light.
beats.continuity: Same Abdul as the hook: white kufi, mustard hoodie, red backpack. He just arrived at Navy Pier.

beats.objective: DISCOVERY: on Navy Pier by the Ferris wheel, Mia (purple raincoat, hair puffs) studies an upside-down map and Leo (round glasses, green fox sweater) holds his rumbling tummy. Abdul notices them with a folded map and a snack bag, caring curiosity.
mustShow: Abdul holding map and snack bag
beats.continuity: Same pier and golden morning light as scene 2. Abdul still has his red backpack and kufi.

beats.objective: HELPING: Abdul runs in with cap flying, handing his map to Mia and his snack to Leo; their worried faces turn into delighted smiles. Three hands meeting is the key image.
beats.continuity: Same map and snack bag from scene 3. Same pier and Ferris wheel.

beats.objective: FOOD: cozy red-checkered booth in a Chicago pizzeria, vegetarian cheese deep-dish pizza with a long cheese pull, Abdul serving Leo, Mia clapping, lit Navy Pier Ferris wheel through the window at golden hour.
beats.continuity: Same three friends. Same Navy Pier Ferris wheel seen from the pizzeria window.

beats.objective: PLAY AND IMAGINATION: Mia, Leo and Abdul jump in front of Cloud Gate (the Bean) in Millennium Park, silly stretched reflections, skyline reflected, pigeons, soccer ball, golden sparkles.
beats.continuity: Same three friends, same outfits. Millennium Park is a new location, same group.

beats.objective: FAREWELL, FULL CIRCLE: golden-hour sunset on Navy Pier, same railing and Ferris wheel as the opening. Abdul hugs Mia and Leo, holds up his sticker journal with a glowing Illinois star sticker, looks at camera ready to wave goodbye.
beats.continuity: Back at Navy Pier, same place as scenes 2-4, now at sunset. Same outfits and friends.
